20 questions

Budget & ordering

How much do kitchen cabinets cost in Chicago?

A useful cabinet budget depends on the cabinet schedule, construction, finish, accessories and installation scope. Compare quotes for the same layout and inclusions. Amber Leaf pricing is provided through a project-specific quote; the illustrative collections here are not a pricebook.

What should a cabinet quote include?

Look for a cabinet-by-cabinet schedule, material and finish specifications, hardware, delivery, assembly, installation, taxes and exclusions. Ask who is responsible for measurements and changes.

How do stock, semi-custom and custom cabinet prices differ?

Stock cabinets use established configurations; semi-custom lines offer selected modifications; custom work can respond more closely to a specific design. The final cost depends on the product and scope, rather than the label alone.

Can I plan for cabinets without installation?

Yes. Choose supply-only in the planner to record that preference. Confirm available supply and installation options with the team before committing to an order.

How do I start if I do not know my measurements?

Choose “Not sure yet” in the planner. Begin with a kitchen layout, style and priorities, then use the measuring guide to prepare dimensions for a design conversation.

Materials & durability

How long do kitchen cabinets last?

Service life varies with construction, hardware, moisture exposure, use and maintenance. Review component specifications, repair options and warranty terms rather than relying on a universal lifespan.

What are the best cabinet materials?

Choose materials by component and use. Doors, cabinet boxes, shelves and finishes have different requirements. Ask about moisture resistance, stability, maintenance and documented product specifications.

How do custom cabinets compare with builder grade?

“Builder grade” does not describe one universal construction standard. Compare an actual specification with the proposed custom cabinet, including box material, hardware, dimensions, finish and service scope.

What is the difference between solid wood, plywood and MDF?

Solid wood uses lumber; plywood uses bonded wood veneers; MDF uses bonded wood fibers. These materials serve different functions. A cabinet may use a combination, so ask which material is used in each component.

What sustainability documentation should I request?

Ask for product-specific sourcing and emissions documentation, certification scope, durability and repair information. A broad environmental label is less useful than evidence linked to the exact material or product.

Design & planning

What is the difference between Shaker and modern slab cabinets?

Shaker doors have a frame surrounding a recessed panel. Slab doors have a flat face. Both can work in contemporary spaces; color, proportion, hardware and the surrounding room influence the result.

Should I choose white oak or maple?

Start with the grain and finish you prefer, then compare the actual door construction, finish samples and product specifications. Species alone does not establish the price or performance of a complete cabinet.

How many cabinets fit in my kitchen?

Cabinet capacity depends on usable wall lengths, openings, appliances, clearances and cabinet dimensions. Our five- and twelve-cabinet examples show sample packages; they are not formulas based on room area.

Why should I see finish samples in person?

Natural grain and color can look different under your room’s lighting and on a screen. Viewing a physical sample helps you compare finishes with flooring, worktops and adjacent materials.

Can a design work around existing appliances and plumbing?

Record existing appliance dimensions, service locations and anything that must stay. A final design needs checks for openings, installation requirements and access before it is ready to order.

Delivery, installation & support

How long does cabinet installation take?

Timing depends on layout, site readiness, assembly, delivery and the surrounding trades. Request a schedule for your exact scope and confirm what must be completed before cabinetry arrives.

How long will my cabinet order take to arrive?

Lead times depend on the product, finish, availability and project requirements. Confirm a current written lead time before placing an order.

Which Chicago-area locations are included?

Our location guide covers Chicago and the sixteen surrounding communities listed on this site. Confirm coverage, delivery and installation arrangements for your exact address with the team.

How do you support contractors and developers?

Amber Leaf collaborates with general contractors and developers on projects ranging from 5 to 5,000 units. Use the professional planning path to record repeated layouts, unit count, phasing and specification priorities.

What if a cabinet arrives damaged or needs support?

Keep your order reference, photograph the issue and contact the supplying team before discarding packaging or beginning repairs. Confirm the applicable damage-reporting and warranty process in your order documents.
